info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to throw, to  make something fly

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: kAlayati - drAvayati ityarTaH . ' kAlayati - prerayati ' iti tattvaboDinI . dantopaGAtaM kAlayati ' hiMsArTAyAm ' (3.4.48) ityatra . ' kaleH kAlayati kzepe, gatisaMKyAnayordvayoH . kalayet SabdasaMKyAnavizaye kalane Sapi ' (Slo. 155) iti devaH .

examples: 'Druvasya putro BagavAn kAlo lokaprakAlanaH' (hari॰1.3.39). praSabdaH prakarze. prakalayati sADu saYcazwe Ayuriti kAlaH. sa eva lokaprakAlanaH.
'pravfdDamArujya mahIpraroham. prakAlayanneva sa pArTivOGAn krudDo'ntakaH prARaBfto yaTEva' (BA॰Adi॰193.5). prakAlayan praRudannityarTaH.
'prakAlyamAnastenAyaM SUlahastena rakzasA. agnyagAraM prati dvAri mayA dorByAM nivAritaH' (BA॰vana॰137.7).. ukto'rTaH .
'taM prakAlayEtA gA brahmabanDa ityabravIt' (CAM॰u॰18.2). iha prakAlanaM prAjanaM Bavati.
'yajYe yajYe yaTAkAlaM dakziRA atyakAlayat' (BA0 droRa0 57.5). atyakAlayat=adadAt. apodaharaditi SabdArTaH.

'gAva utkAlitapuMskA bAhAya ca vikrayAya ca striya evAvaSizyante. kaH punararhatyagrAmyARAM puMsa utkAlayituM ye grahItumaSakyAH kuta eva bAhAya ca vikrayAya ca' (pA0 1.2.73 sUtre BAzyam). utkAlitapuMskAH=nizkAsitapumBAvAH.
